title: THE BALLON D'OR WINNER WITH ZERO SOCIAL MEDIA ACCOUNTS
description:
No post, no story, no reel. Rodri let the football do the talking.

Rodri won the 2024 Ballon d'Or, the first Manchester City winner. As a kid he picked the park and his village over social media, he told the BBC. He used to carry his bike on the train to Villarreal B training. Now the Ballon d'Or needs a bigger bag.

In 2023 he scored the only goal of the Champions League final against Inter. One goal, one final, zero captions.

At the 2026 World Cup he took the Golden Ball with zero goals and zero assists. He covered ninety-six kilometres, the most of anyone.

Golden Ball for cardio and calm: right call or a stretch? Yes or no in the comments.
